races.paceDynamic: Endofastorm is the only confirmed front-runner and will set a sustainable pace without pressure from the early stages. The remaining seven runners all show hold-up tendencies, creating a scenario where the pace-setter gets an easy lead into the home straight. With good to firm ground suiting Bath's downhill finish, the lack of pace pressure means Endofastorm can dictate terms and save energy for a strong finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and early pace-setters who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge when seven hold-up horses converge in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Endofastorm gets an easy early lead without harassment from the field
scenarios.body: The pace-setter conserves energy through soft fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges down Bath's demanding hill. Hold-up horses get bunched up behind and struggle to make up the ground on good to firm going.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the slow pace allows multiple hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks simultaneously
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means several closers arrive with one devastating run, overwhelming the tiring leader. Class and finishing speed become decisive factors in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the field gets severely bunched turning for home with multiple horses looking for racing room
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered in the melee while one or two find clear passage to capitalize. The race becomes more about luck and position than ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the obvious contenders underperform or encounter trouble in running
scenarios.body: A lesser-fancied runner with fresh conditions or improved fitness takes advantage of a moderate pace and weak competition. Recent course experience or stable confidence proves crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Rating sits as the lone prominent runner with Bobby Dassler potentially joining him, creating a sustainable pace without early pressure. The remaining five runners - Party Island, Thapa Vc, Raintown, Moby Quick, and Paps Of Jura - all adopt hold-up tactics, setting up a race where the leaders can dictate terms. With such a heavy concentration of hold-up horses, Rating can control the tempo and kick clear when the backmarkers are still organizing their challenges. This pace dynamic strongly favours the early positioned horses who can avoid traffic and time their moves effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Rating Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Rating and Bobby Dassler establish a comfortable early lead without pressure from the hold-up brigade.
scenarios.body: Rating can dictate a steady pace before quickening, while the packed field of hold-up horses creates traffic problems in the straight. The early leaders benefit from a clear run while the backmarkers struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and sets up the race for a closer to pick off tired leaders.
scenarios.body: Party Island or Thapa Vc can capitalize on their proven class and finishing kicks to sweep past weakening front-runners. The experienced campaigners have the tactical speed to navigate through traffic when gaps appear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Raintown Resurgence
scenarios.trigger: If Raintown's 88-day absence proves beneficial and he shows renewed vigor off his reduced mark.
scenarios.body: Despite the long layoff, his class on his day could see him produce a bold performance when the others have shown their limitations. The drop in weights and fresh legs might prove decisive in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Rating goes too slow early and the race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win.
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace setters creates a messy finale where track position and luck in running becomes paramount. Moby Quick or Bobby Dassler could benefit from being closer to the pace when the sprint develops.

races.paceDynamic: Alkuwarrior will lead uncontested from the start, setting a comfortable pace over this sprint trip. Four horses - Saucy Jane, Duskaura, Solar Invincible and Guernsey Angel - will fight for prominent positions behind the leader, creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning into the straight. The hold-up horses Comic Strip, Angel Numbers, Artista, London Is Blue and Alvin will need clear runs in the final two furlongs to deploy their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can secure clear racing room, as the hold-up brigade face significant traffic concerns with seven runners needing late gaps.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Alkuwarrior gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on his rivals while the prominent pack squabble behind, with hold-up horses trapped in traffic turning for home. Alkuwarrior's 252-day absence becomes irrelevant as tactical position trumps fitness concerns.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners sort themselves out without serious interference
scenarios.body: Solar Invincible and Saucy Jane get clear runs from their forward positions while Alkuwarrior weakens and the hold-up horses get caught in traffic. Recent course winner Solar Invincible benefits from proven track form and cheekpieces.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners create enough pace to set up a strong finish
scenarios.body: Comic Strip finds the rail run that transforms his AW form to turf, with Alvin benefiting from his proven 5f speed despite the wide draw creating early positioning problems. The sustained pace exposes stamina doubts in the front division.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Alkuwarrior goes too fast early or the prominent runners fail to pressure
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f marker, suiting closers who normally need more pace but can now use raw speed. London Is Blue's Brighton wins become relevant as he gets the fast-finishing scenario his turf form suggests he needs.

races.paceDynamic: So Smart will take the field along as the only confirmed front-runner, with Solar Edge likely to track him in second through the early stages. With limited pace pressure from just these two early leaders, So Smart can dictate comfortable fractions without being harried. The five hold-up horses (The Thames Boatman, Moe's Legacy, Toolatetonegotiate, The Feminine Urge, Diamondsinthesand) will settle behind and rely on a finishing kick over this minimum trip. This tactical setup clearly favours the front-runner and prominent racer who can avoid traffic problems and control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: So Smart Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart gets an easy lead without early pressure from Solar Edge
scenarios.body: So Smart can dictate steady fractions and have enough left to resist late challenges, while Solar Edge benefits from the perfect tracking position. The hold-up horses face the usual 5f problem of limited time to make up ground from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Contested Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Edge or another runner pushes So Smart from the start
scenarios.body: Both early leaders could weaken in the final furlong, opening the door for the best finishers to sweep past. The Feminine Urge and Moe's Legacy have the class to capitalize on a strong pace collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horses Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up turning for home with multiple hold-up runners seeking room
scenarios.body: Several of the back-markers will find trouble in running, allowing the leaders to maintain their advantage. So Smart's front-running position becomes even more valuable when others are shuffling for racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart goes too fast early or Solar Edge forces a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The entire field could come back to the hold-up horses in a sprint finish. Diamondsinthesand's light weight and The Thames Boatman's second-place finish here last year become crucial factors.

races.paceDynamic: Eupator and Special Ghaiyyath will contest the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front runners likely to ensure an honest gallop from the start. The pace should be solid rather than frantic given only two natural leaders, allowing the quartet of hold-up horses (Happy Banner, Candonomore, Nakaaha, Caledonian) to get into contention. With most of the field preferring to come from off the pace, this sets up ideally for the prominent runners and those with tactical speed to position themselves handy - specifically benefiting horses like Aspull who can race in second or third and strike when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Aspull can track the pace and time his run perfectly
scenarios.body: The front two will set it up for something sitting third or fourth to come through. Aspull's prominent style and quality jockey booking suggests he can exploit this position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Special Ghaiyyath can dictate a measured pace and kick clear
scenarios.body: His recent form and change of yard suggests improvement, and controlling the tempo from the front could see him hold on. The lack of early pressure might allow him to conserve energy for a late kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is messy and one of the bigger prices gets first run
scenarios.body: Caledonian or Happy Banner could exploit any tactical errors with their hold-up styles. Long absences or stable changes sometimes produce surprise improvers in small competitive handicaps.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Special Ghaiyyath and Eupator go too fast early - this will set up the race perfectly for the closers
Monitor Aspull's market moves as gelded horses returning from breaks can show significant improvement
Check Candonomore's position turning in as he's clearly the form horse and will be hard to beat if getting first run
Observe if Nakaaha travels better than at Doncaster as she may have been rusty that day
Watch for any late money on Caledonian given his low mileage and stable returning him after a long break

races.name: Signs Express Proudly Support Bath Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Miss Mambo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid C&D third last time out, but faces tougher handicap company
runners_data.comment: Ran well in recent C&D maiden and could have some improvement to come in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Gave pretty good account when third of six in C&D (good to soft) maiden won comfortably by short-odds favourite ten days ago, her fourth start, and could have some improvement to come in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Beryl's Girl
runners_data.note: Returns from 226-day break but showed promise in her final juvenile start at this venue
runners_data.comment: Ended three-race 2yo campaign with third in C&D maiden; makes handicap debut today
runners_data.spotlight: Ended three-race 2yo campaign with quite promising third in C&D (good to soft) maiden in September, albeit in a slowly run race; makes handicap debut after 226-day absence but has potential.

runners_data.name: Zoustellar
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with recent winning form, perfectly positioned if pace develops ahead

runners_data.name: Denby's Dream
runners_data.note: Maiden but improving, hold-up style suits if leaders go too fast early
runners_data.comment: Ran on well for second at Lingfield this month and remains unexposed over 1m
runners_data.spotlight: A maiden after seven starts but encountered some traffic before running on well to snatch second (no threat to winner) at Lingfield (1m, AW) a fortnight ago and remains unexposed over this trip; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Arvana Belle
runners_data.note: Nursery winner returning from 210-day absence, prominent style may face pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Ended last season in good form in Brighton nurseries; upped in trip for reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Scored on nursery debut at Brighton (6f, good) in August and finished close up there (6f/7f) on next two outings; upped in trip again for this reappearance outing; won't be far away if fully tuned out.

runners_data.name: Takeitorleaveit
runners_data.note: Previous C&D winner who could benefit from returning to successful venue and tactics
runners_data.comment: Won soft-ground C&D nursery in September; off since lesser effort in October
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed improvement to reward strong market support over C&D (soft; first-time cheekpieces) on nursery debut in September; off since a lesser effort in October, though, and needs to prove himself on today's much faster ground.

runners_data.name: Mali Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but inconsistent form pattern makes him harder to trust despite winter gelding
runners_data.comment: Unplaced all five 2yo starts but improvement is possible this year
runners_data.spotlight: Just a respectable fifth on nursery debut at Southwell (1m, AW) in October and below that form at Chelmsford the following month; gelded during the winter, though, and improvement is possible this year.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Mambo and the prominent contingent (Beryl's Girl, Arvana Belle, Takeitorleaveit) will contest the early lead, but with only seven runners this creates a measured rather than frantic gallop. The hold-up pair Zoustellar and Denby's Dream will track from the rear, while Mali Star sits midfield. With multiple prominent runners willing to take it on early, the pace should be honest without being suicidal, setting up a staying test over the final two furlongs. This tactical setup clearly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalise on the pace battle ahead of them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalise
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage in pace pressure from halfway
scenarios.body: The early leaders burn each other out in a sustained battle, allowing the patient back-markers to pick up the pieces. Zoustellar and Denby's Dream benefit from their tactical position and finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tactics prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Mambo or Takeitorleaveit establish a soft lead without pressure
scenarios.body: The winner dictates terms from the front, keeping enough in reserve to repel late challengers. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint finish develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian with all prominent runners checking each other
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair turning into a sprint finish where raw speed trumps stamina. Fresh legs and finishing pace become crucial over tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying test emerges
scenarios.trigger: If genuine end-to-end gallop develops from flag fall
scenarios.body: The sustained pace finds out stamina limitations, favouring horses with proven staying ability at the trip. Course specialists and those with mile form come to the fore.

watchPoints.text: Zoustellar's finishing kick if the prominent runners engage early - his hold-up style perfectly suited to capitalise
Miss Mambo's early positioning - if she can establish an uncontested lead her C&D form makes her dangerous
Takeitorleaveit's market support given his previous C&D success when prominent
The pace battle between multiple prominent runners creating opportunities for back-markers
Beryl's Girl's fitness after 226 days off despite her promising juvenile form at the venue
